B.domain: Subtraction of fractions and mixed numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize denominators
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when the denominators differ.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the same denominator.
Tag for mixed-number problems if only the fractional parts are rewritten to a common denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the fractions already have the same denominator.
Do not tag for rewriting a whole number as a mixed number with 0 over a denominator unless a common-denominator conversion is also performed.
Do not tag for simplifying a result after subtraction.

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a subtraction-ready form, such as adding a 0-fraction part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized to a standard mixed number.
Tag when a mixed number is explicitly decomposed into whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for finding a common denominator between unlike fractions.
Do not tag for the actual subtraction of whole parts or fraction parts once the operands are already in usable form.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping after subtraction has begun.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with a shared denominator and/or subtract the whole-number and fractional parts of mixed numbers once the forms are aligned.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a common denominator.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted directly.
Tag when a zero fractional result or zero whole result is obtained through subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for creating common denominators or equivalent fractions.
Do not tag for rewriting operands into standard form before subtraction.
Do not tag for borrowing/regrouping to fix a negative fractional part.
Do not tag for simplifying or expressing the final answer in lowest terms.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow 1 from the whole part when the fractional subtraction is negative, and simplify or combine the result into lowest-term fraction, mixed number, or integer form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when 1 whole is regrouped as denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when a negative fractional difference triggers borrowing from the whole part.
Tag when the result is simplified to lowest terms.
Tag when the final whole and fractional parts are combined into a mixed number or integer after subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag for merely subtracting aligned fractions or whole parts when no regrouping or simplification/combining is shown.
Do not tag for finding a common denominator.
Do not tag for initial rewriting of operands such as converting a whole number to include 0 over a denominator.

C.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including normalization, common denominators, borrowing, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize operands
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number or nonstandard mixed number into a compatible form for subtraction, such as adding a zero fractional part or converting an improper fractional part to a standard mixed number.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution rewrites a whole number as a whole plus 0/n to align fractional parts.
Tag when a solution converts a mixed number with an improper fraction part into an equivalent standard mixed number.
Tag when a solution explicitly rewrites a mixed number into separated whole and fractional parts to set up subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when the step only finds a common denominator without rewriting the operand structure.
Do not tag when the step only performs subtraction on already compatible forms.
Do not tag when the step only combines final whole and fractional results.

skills.name: Match denominators
skills.definition: Create equivalent fractions with a common denominator so fractional parts can be subtracted.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike fractional parts.
Tag when a solution converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with that denominator.
Tag when this is done inside fraction-only problems or within mixed-number fraction parts.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag when the step only subtracts numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag borrowing steps that add n/n to a fraction after regrouping from the whole part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with matched denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts when the quantities are already in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution subtracts numerators of fractions that already share a denominator.
Tag when a solution subtracts whole parts of mixed numbers or whole-minus-whole components.
Tag when a solution performs direct subtraction of whole and fractional parts without borrowing.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create common denominators.
Do not tag regrouping or borrowing steps used because the fractional part would otherwise be negative.
Do not tag simplification-only steps such as reducing 2/10 to 1/5 or 0/3 to 0.

skills.name: Regroup and simplify
skills.definition: Borrow one whole to continue subtraction when the fractional part is too small, and reduce or express the final result in lowest terms or standard form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to n/n for the fractional subtraction.
Tag when a solution simplifies a fraction to lowest terms or simplifies a zero fraction to an integer.
Tag when a solution combines the resulting whole and fractional parts into a standard final mixed number or integer after regrouping or simplification.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag straightforward subtraction steps that require no borrowing and no simplification.
Do not tag initial rewriting of operands before subtraction; that belongs to normalization.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion before subtraction.

A.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Equalize fraction units
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and rewrite fractional parts as equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a solution explicitly finds an LCD/common denominator.
Tag when one or both fractions are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators.
Tag for mixed-number problems when only the fractional parts are equalized.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no equivalent-fraction conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere rewriting of a whole number as n + 0/d unless it is part of borrowing rather than denominator matching.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2 unless a common denominator is also found.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Subtract fractions with like denominators and/or subtract whole-number parts once the quantities are in compatible form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when numerators are subtracted over a shared denominator.
Tag when whole parts of mixed numbers are subtracted.
Tag when a mixed number and a whole/fraction are decomposed into whole and fractional parts and those aligned parts are subtracted.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step that creates common denominators; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag simplification such as reducing 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0; that belongs to S04.

skills.name: Regroup mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a quantity to make subtraction possible by normalizing an improper mixed number or borrowing 1 whole into fractional units.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when an improper mixed number is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a whole number is rewritten as a whole plus 0/d in preparation for mixed-number subtraction with borrowing.
Tag when 1 whole is borrowed and converted into d/d to continue the subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction of already-compatible whole and fraction parts when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag finding a common denominator between unlike denominators; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag final reduction or combining of the result unless regrouping itself occurs in that step.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the computed result to lowest terms and present it in an appropriate final form such as fraction, mixed number, whole number, or 0.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction is reduced, such as 2/10 to 1/5 or 9/12 to 3/4.
Tag when 0 over a denominator is simplified to 0.
Tag when whole and fractional parts are combined into a final mixed number or integer after computation.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the arithmetic subtraction itself; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag borrowing or normalization steps; those belong to S03.
Do not tag equivalent-fraction conversion for common denominators; that belongs to S01.
